attributes.size: initial average grain size about 50 µm

evidence.quote: The initial average grain size of the Ti-15-3 alloy was about 50 µm, and the average grain size increased to about 130 µm after 1 min at 1093 °C. The grain size had stabilized at about 240 µm after 5 min at 1093 °C.

The initial grain size of the heat treated Ti-6-4 alloy was small, at approximately 10 µm, and grain size increased to about 260 µm after 3.5 min at 1093 °C and to about 320 µm after 3.5 min at 1316 °C.
